filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English coverage is complete, featuring highly-rated videos from established educational channels for all topics. For Arabic, one topic, 'Functional Completeness', had no relevant videos available in the candidate pool; all shortlisted videos for this topic were either on unrelated subjects or in the wrong language. The other four Arabic topics are well-covered by popular and relevant videos.
